lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15-18 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid of three visible horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with highest pixel intensity concentrated at the geometric centers of each blob.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the circular blobs on the far-left lateral flank, forming a low-contrast rectangular coordinate system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single dominant horizontal linear feature visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity dorsal light to low-intensity shadow beneath the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical branchial slits exhibiting high-contrast shadowing; secondary grouping of smaller, less-defined high-luminance spots localized between the first and second gill openings.
